meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当编排者:先派子代理去查文档、找出真实可用的 API,再产出分阶段的实施计划;每个阶段带文档引用、验证清单和要避开的反模式,计划可拿到新对话里逐阶段执行。
howto.when: 当你要求为一个功能、任务或多步实施做计划时触发,尤其是在交给 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个功能做一份分阶段实施计划
say.note: 它会先做文档调研,再写出各阶段

say.text: 每个阶段要能在新对话里独立执行,并附文档引用
say.note: 计划会带每阶段的文档出处和验证步骤

say.text: 先查清真实可用的 API,再按阶段拆计划

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: subagents gather documentation and real API signatures first, then it writes a phased implementation plan with doc references, verification checklists and anti-pattern guards. Each phase is self-contained and can run in a new chat.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing it with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this feature
say_en.note: It runs doc discovery first, then phases

say_en.text: Each phase should run in a new chat with doc references
say_en.note: Phases get doc sources and checks

say_en.text: Find the real available APIs before splitting the work into phases
